{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only (exclude refunded)
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_test_orders = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA test orders: {len(qa_test_orders)}')

# Remove QA test orders
df_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute average revenue per order by channel
grouped = df_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean().round(2)

# Print results
print(grouped)

# Also compute total revenue by channel for verification
total_revenue = df_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum().round(2)
print(total_revenue)"}
